registration: 3 manually selected outline controls to official Purdue GIS; hand-affine fit, approximately +/-1m, not survey
threshold: luminance <0.8 and chroma <0.16; dominant straight directions 0/45/90/135 degrees; centerline runs >=1.25m; short joins <=3 pixels
exclusions: near-GIS-boundary traces under 1.2m, manually masked stair-core boxes, traces under 1.25m
